title: Lesson 18: Capstone — Design & Run a Real System — js-tools
desc: Combining all 17 lessons into one real URL shortener, then measuring each patch round: throughput from 6,115 to 25,786 req/s and p99 from 14.71 down to 1.28 ms. But the three numbers in between are the ones worth remembering — caching eliminates 99% of read queries but only lifts throughput 16% because the bottleneck is on the write path; the most worthwhile step is a requirements decision, not a technical trick (letting click stats lag by a few seconds, throughput ×3.6); and a read replica — reasonable on every diagram — delivers exactly 0% because the cache already absorbed all the reads.
